mentions.name: Vintage Presents
mentions.description: An e-commerce platform for vintage collectibles where search and navigation are organized by date, making it easier to find birthday and anniversary gifts. It is built as a multi-vendor platform so other sellers can join over time; currently the author is the sole seller, offering a childhood comic and coin collection, and the UK-based site has just launched.
mentions.problem: Helping people find interesting and original birthday presents and anniversary gifts.
mentions.audience: Shoppers looking for interesting and original birthday presents and anniversary gifts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built https://vintagepresents.com/ to try to sell my childhood comic and coin collections.

I believe it is the first eCommerce platform where all the products have date as an important feature and where the search and navigation are by date - the thinking being it could help people find interesting and original birthday presents and anniversary gifts. I've also built it as a multi-vendor platform so it can hopefully live on once I've sold my things.
mentions.author: m-i-l
